topic.title: Commenting and Suggesting Changes
topic.shortdesc: As reviewers in a review task, Subject-Matter Experts can add comments to explain issues and suggest changes to propose specific edits.

body.p: Comments and suggestions are the main ways reviewers provide feedback in . Subject-Matter Experts usually provide this feedback while participating in a task as reviewers. Use comments when you want to explain an issue or raise a question. Use suggestions when you want to propose a direct change to the content.

ul.li: Comments are useful for questions, concerns, and general feedback.
Suggestions are useful when you know the exact change you want to propose.
Keep the feedback short and clear.
Explain why a change is needed when the reason is not obvious.

section.title: What happens next
section.p: Authors or task owners review the feedback and decide which changes to accept. Clear comments and precise suggestions make that work easier.
